statement: No role in this record is filled by a party outside the project. The production party declares no identity, account, organisation, infrastructure or signing key. Every assertion of independence in the existing evidence is therefore refused, and no existing claim is upgraded by this record.

sameness_levels.description: The two roles are performed by one agent: the same declared identity, the same account, or the same undeclared producing party.
sameness_levels.independence_consequence: Fails every independence requirement. A different role label is not a different agent.

sameness_levels.description: The two roles belong to one organisation, or neither declares an organisation so that distinct organisations are not established.
sameness_levels.independence_consequence: Fails a trust-domain requirement; absence of a declaration is never read as difference.

sameness_levels.description: The two roles run on one infrastructure operator: the same working environment, the same court image, or two URLs under one operator.
sameness_levels.independence_consequence: Fails a trust-domain requirement even when the identity strings differ.

sameness_levels.description: The two roles sign with one key, or neither declares a key so that key distinctness is not established.
sameness_levels.independence_consequence: Fails a trust-domain requirement; an undeclared key is not a distinct key.

roles.name: Author
may_assert: the claim proposition, its interpretation, quantification, scope and threat model
the assumptions the claim depends on
an exclusion argument and its claimed procedure
roles.note: The author may also be the proof producer or evidence producer; those overlaps are recorded but do not by themselves refuse the claim.

roles.name: Proof producer
may_assert: that a proof object establishes a stated property under stated axioms
the proof checker, axioms and admitted results
roles.note: A proof is evidence about a model, not a verdict about the candidate. The adjudicator may not be the proof producer for a discharge.

roles.name: Instrument author
may_assert: what the instrument measures and does not measure
the instrument's qualification record and known limits
roles.note: The instrument author may be the evidence producer. The adjudicator may not adjudicate an instrument the adjudicator wrote.

roles.name: Evidence producer
may_assert: the measured result, its artefact identity and its digest binding
the environment and invocation in which the result was produced
roles.note: An evidence producer who also adjudicates is the same agent accepting its own run.

roles.name: Adjudicator
may_assert: the verdict for a named claim at a named candidate identity
which obligations are discharged, retained or newly introduced
roles.note: Distinctness is required at same_agent for the high claim classes. For an independent adjudication the adjudicator must be a different agent, not a different role label.

roles.name: Reviewer
may_assert: that a stated procedure was applied to a stated obligation and result
the reviewer's identity, role and the review artefact
roles.note: This is the ETP-1 exclusion-witness reviewer. The witness checker already refuses a reviewer whose declared role or identity equals the claim author's.

roles.name: Independent reproducer
may_assert: that a rebuild from the frozen package in the reproducer's own trust domain reproduced the stated observables
the reproducer's environment, inputs and result digests
roles.note: Requires difference at all four sameness levels. A second account, a second URL under one operator, a second directory in this repository, or a rebuild that consumes a project-produced artefact is not a different trust domain.

roles.name: Release authority
may_assert: the release or graduation decision and the risks it accepts
the scope and the named residuals of the decision
roles.note: A release decision may accept risk, but it may not present that acceptance as an independent assurance verdict.

roles.name: Revocation authority
may_assert: that a claim is withdrawn, superseded or revoked, and the reason
the effective time and the replacement claim
roles.note: A party may not revoke its own claim in a way that erases the record; revocation preserves the revoked claim and its dissent.

claim_classes.description: A documentary or measured claim that does not assert independence.
A reusable unsafe boundary whose obligations are declared discharged.
A consumer-family graduation or release decision.
An adjudication that asserts independence from the claim it judges.
A release-gate decision that is not a SAFE_COMPATIBLE graduation.

rules.refuses: a claim that asserts independent review with no reviewer identity, role or artefact
an adjudicator not distinct from the author where the claim class requires independence
two reviewers with the same identity, account or signing key
a distinct-party threshold met only by aliases of one party, including one account under two names and one infrastructure operator under two URLs
an independent-reproduction claim whose reproducer used this repository's working environment or a project-produced artefact instead of a rebuild from the frozen package
a retained dissent that is absent from the aggregate, or an aggregate better than a retained dissent

adjudicator_versus_author.statement: For a SAFE_COMPATIBLE graduation, a SAFETY_DISCHARGED verdict, or an independent adjudication, the adjudicator must not be the author.

reproducer_versus_project.statement: The reproducer must be a different trust domain, not merely a different name. All four sameness levels must be established as different.

release_authority_versus_adjudicator.statement: The release decision may accept risk, but the party deciding the release is not the party that adjudicated the claim.

non_claims: A distinct role label is not a distinct party.
A distinct identity string is not a distinct organisation, infrastructure or key.
Two builds in one environment are two executions, not two trust domains.
An independent reference implementation written by the author is model diversity, not reviewer independence.
A clean-room replay in this repository is self-reproduction, not external reproduction.
This record does not create, and must not be read as creating, any external reviewer, organisation or key.
